writer.product: Snowflake-managed Iceberg table on an external volume

provenance: Written by a real Snowflake account on 2026-08-22 via CREATE ICEBERG TABLE on an external
volume backed by Azure ADLS Gen2. polytable has never written into this directory.
Rescued to local disk minutes before the Azure account was deleted; it cannot be
regenerated without another Snowflake instance and an external volume.
notes: This is the only fixture here written by a commercial engine. Every other fixture comes
from delta-rs or pyiceberg, which is the writer-axis gap docs/interoperability-coverage.md
Snowflake writes NO version-hint.text, so a reader that refuses to guess (DuckDB by
default) will not open it without unsafe_enable_version_guessing.
Metadata file names are 00000-<uuid>.metadata.json, not v1.metadata.json.
Column names are UPPER CASE, as Snowflake writes them.
Absolute locations in the JSON metadata are rewritten to path_placeholder, following the
convention in test/fixtures/generate.py. Paths inside the Avro manifests are the original
abfss:// ones and are NOT relocatable, exactly as for the pyiceberg fixtures.
